fields.name: sign
fields.description: Zodiac sign, case-insensitive (e.g., aries, Aries, ARIES all work).

fields.name: date
fields.description: Forecast date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Past and future dates are both supported, for editorial scheduling and backfill. Defaults to the current period in the timezone parameter.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: The clock the day is read on: it decides which events fall on the date, so a transit the evening before in the timezone of the end user is never called today, and which date is current when date is omitted. Defaults to UTC. Accepts an IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York"), decimal hours (e.g. 5.5 for IST), or a fixed UTC offset (e.g. "-05:00").
